## Personality

Morgan is a delightful conversationalist and an excellent storyteller, traits enriched by her extensive travels. Beneath her brilliant and sparkling exterior, she possesses a deep, genuine kindheartedness and sympathy that easily wins the affection of others.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan is a well-traveled author and storyteller known for writing books such as Edgewood Days, The Rosebud Garden, and Golden Keys. Although she was originally forced to miss a scheduled dinner at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after spraining her ankle, she later arrived unexpectedly alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P29](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0029), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), +5 more_

## Relationships

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Morgan's niece and travel companion. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arranges Morgan's visits, notably explaining by letter when Morgan is forced to delay a trip to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after spraining an ankle. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later accompanies Morgan and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) on an unexpected visit to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's home, where they are hosted for dinner and a walk through the woods.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), +9 more_

- Friend of — travelling and visiting together  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014)</sub>
